content.short: Zolve gives immigrants and international students US bank accounts and credit cards without a US credit history.
content.description: Zolve is a cross-border neobank that helps global citizens, especially students and professionals moving to the United States, set up their finances as soon as they arrive. Through partner banks it lets newcomers open a US checking account with a competitive yield and get a credit card with a limit up to 15,000 dollars, without a US credit history or social security number, using their home-country profile to underwrite them. Zolve also offers international transfers, loans, insurance and even SIM cards and visa help. Trusted by more than a million students from over 185 countries, it targets internationally mobile students and workers by solving the classic no-US-credit-history barrier that migrants face.
content.meta: Zolve offers US bank accounts and credit cards for immigrants and international students. Discover Zolve and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
